name: Quad9
tagline: Threat-blocking recursive DNS with free DoH, DoT, and DNSCrypt endpoints for secure resolution.
description: Quad9 is a free recursive DNS service that blocks malware and phishing domains via threat intelligence. Developers and apps use its public DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH), DNS-over-TLS (DoT), and DNSCrypt endpoints for secure name resolution without signup. Multiple endpoint variants offer different privacy and filtering policies; no API key is required for standard recursive use.

auth.details: No authentication required for public recursive DNS/DoH/DoT endpoints. Optional enterprise/logging variants may differ; standard endpoints are open.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public recursive DNS/DoH with no published request quota for standard endpoints
pricing.paid_plans: Enterprise/custom options via Quad9; standard public service is free

use_cases: resolve a domain to A/AAAA records over DoH
check if a hostname is blocked as malware by Quad9
configure app DNS to use threat-blocking recursive resolvers
query DNS over HTTPS with application/dns-json
switch between Quad9 filtered and unfiltered endpoint variants
